about: Shared payload corpus. Each case applies its edits to a base payload (meta.data.json, prices.data.json, eda.data.json, stationarity.data.json, acf_pacf.data.json, aic_grid.data.json, fit.data.json or residuals_aic.data.json in this folder) and states whether the result is valid. tests/test_payload_corpus.py runs every case through Python's validate_meta, validate_prices, validate_eda, validate_stationarity, validate_acf_pacf, validate_aic_grid, validate_fit and validate_residuals (model aic), and src/lib/contract.payloads.corpus.test.ts runs the same cases through parseMeta, parsePrices, parseEda, parseStationarity, parseAcfPacf, parseAicGrid, parseFit and parseResiduals, so the two readers cannot disagree on any of them. An edit is {path, value} or {path, delete: true}; value is written as JSON, so 4.0 stays a float for Python while JavaScript reads the number 4.
